findings.text: validate() of the registered railway RCC box engine is inside a block comment (lines 106–160): the production app runs no domain validation for this family; the rules above are knowledge, not enforced anywhere.

the half section draws the granular fill from foundation.found_d (fallback 0.85 m) while the rule engine's granBot uses foundation.sand_fill_depth (fallback 0.7 m): the two views can disagree about the foundation depth.
fallback defaults differ between the rule engine and the half section (t_slab_b 0.35 vs 0.400 m): with a field missing, the engine and the drawing use different values.
the family defaults enter hydraulics.soffit_level 99.648 while the engine computes soffit 99.498 from them: the (disabled) soffit consistency rule would warn on the defaults themselves.

compute() reads fields the family defaults do not hold; the code then uses its own constants: barrelLength → None, deck.formation_width → None, deck.formation_width_left → None, deck.formation_width_right → None, formationWidth → None, formationWidthLeft → None, formationWidthRight → None, geometry.no_of_tracks → None, options2d.double_track → None, project.status → None, project.type → None

clear span of one cell (inner face to inner face)
clear height of a cell (top of bottom slab to soffit of top slab)
thickness of each intermediate (inner) wall between cells
haunch size (leg) at the wall–slab junctions
wearing course on the bottom slab (bed level is its top)
embankment side slope, horizontal per vertical (SLOPE n:1)
earth cushion as entered (the engine computes its own from the levels)
granular fill thickness as the half section draws it
PCC sub-base thickness under the bottom slab
sand / granular fill depth under the PCC
bed level: the finished floor, top of the wearing course
soffit level as entered (an input; the engine computes its own soffit)
wing walls are part of the arrangement
EXISTING or PROPOSED structure (an existing one reads ex_formation_lvl / ex_rail_level)
